items.title: [CR-FULL][meta] Exhaustive CodeRabbit residual audit campaign (2026-08)
items.body:
## Summary

Meta-epic for an **exhaustive residual CodeRabbit campaign** on BioETL, complementary to continuous PR App reviews.

CodeRabbit is **not** sole SSOT (see `docs/03-guides/coderabbit-audit-playbook.md`):

1. Code / contracts / config  
2. ADRs + RULES  
3. Architecture tests / quality gates  
4. CodeRabbit findings (must map to evidence)

**Do not increase tech-debt budgets** to silence findings.

## Baseline (at epic open)

- Target: `main` @ `62a8c94ecf4614250bc8e470089361fe7223e8cd` (refresh at CR-FULL-00)
- Config: `.coderabbit.yaml` (`profile: assertive`)
- CI CLI: `.github/workflows/coderabbit.yml`
- Playbook: `docs/03-guides/coderabbit-audit-playbook.md`
- Launcher: `scripts/ops/run-coderabbit-reviews.sh`

## Child issues

| Code | Pri | Issue | Title |
|------|-----|------:|-------|
| CR-FULL-00 | P0 | #7689 | Preflight: freeze baseline, tools, ground-truth gates |
| CR-FULL-01 | P1 | #7690 | Wave A: architecture residual |
| CR-FULL-02 | P1 | #7691 | Wave B: data plane |
| CR-FULL-03 | P1 | #7692 | Wave C: adapters / resilience |
| CR-FULL-04 | P1 | #7693 | Wave D: security |

- [ ] #7689 Preflight

- [ ] #7691 Wave B  
- [ ] #7692 Wave C

- [ ] #7694 Wave E

```text
#7689 → (#7690 ‖ #7691 ‖ #7692 ‖ #7693 ‖ #7694 ‖ #7695 sequential CLI)
```
